definition_en: the ideas, customs and art of a group of people; the growing of plants or cells
core_image: 一群人共同浇灌出来的一片精神花园
scene: 美术课上，老师给我们看了很多外国节日和传统服饰的图片。Learning about another country's culture makes the world feel smaller.
sceneCN: 这里 culture 是「文化」（第 1 个义项：一群人共同的思想、习俗与艺术）；句意是了解别国的文化会让世界显得更小、更亲近。

derivatives.zh: 由 culture 加形容词后缀 -al 构成，义为「文化的」
由 cultural 加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「在文化上」
由拉丁词根 agri（田地）加 culture 构成，义为「农业」
由拉丁词根 cult-（耕种）构成，义为「耕作；培养」

senses.title: The customs and art of a group of people
senses.titleCN: 一群人的文化、习俗与艺术
senses.definition: the ideas, beliefs, music, food and ways of living shared by a group
senses.definitionCN: 一个群体共同拥有的想法、信仰、音乐、饮食和生活方式
senses.example: Our class made a poster about food culture in different countries.
senses.exampleCN: 我们班做了一张关于各国饮食文化的海报。
senses.why: A garden grows many plants together; a people grows many shared habits together, so shared living became a garden of the mind.
senses.whyCN: 花园里种着许多植物，一个民族也种出许多共同的习惯，所以共同的活法就像一座心灵花园，这个词便由此长出。

senses.title: Art, music and literature
senses.definition: activities and interests such as music, art, theatre and literature
senses.definitionCN: 音乐、艺术、戏剧、文学之类的活动和兴趣
senses.example: The city offers young people lots of culture, from museums to concerts.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市为年轻人提供了很多文化熏陶，从博物馆到音乐会。
senses.why: Museums and concerts are the most polished flowers in the shared garden, so the word pointed at high art.
senses.whyCN: 博物馆和音乐会是共同花园里最精心培育的花朵，于是这个词便指向高雅艺术。

senses.title: Growing plants or cells
senses.definition: the practice of growing plants, or keeping cells or bacteria alive for study
senses.definitionCN: 种植植物，或为研究而培养细胞、细菌
senses.example: The culture of rice needs warm weather and plenty of water.
senses.exampleCN: 水稻的种植需要温暖的天气和充足的水。
senses.why: The Latin root meant tilling the soil, so growing plants kept the oldest meaning.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根本义是耕作土地，所以「种植物」保留了这个词最古老的意思。

intro.en: Culture grows from a Latin word for working the soil.
intro.cn: culture 从一个表示耕作土地的拉丁词生长而来。

items.en: The verb colere meant to till, to dwell, and to worship; cultura was the noun for tilling the land.
items.cn: 拉丁语动词 colere 意为耕作、居住、崇敬；cultura 是耕地的名词。

items.en: Scholars used cultura to describe tilling the mind, such as cultura animi, the care of the soul.
items.cn: 中世纪学者用 cultura 比喻耕耘心灵，如 cultura animi（心灵的培育）。

items.en: Old French carried couture and culture into learned writing, still close to cultivation.
items.cn: 古法语把 couture、culture 带进书面语，意思仍接近「培育」。

items.en: English took culture in the fifteenth century, first for the growing of crops.
items.cn: 英语在十五世纪吸收 culture，最初指庄稼的种植。

items.en: By the nineteenth century it covered art and shared ways of life, and later science kept it for growing cells.
items.cn: 到十九世纪它已涵盖艺术和共同的生活方式；后来科学界又用它指培养细胞。

note.en: These words share the Latin root colere or describe the shared life of a people.
note.cn: 这些词与拉丁词根 colere 同源，或同样描述一个群体的共同生活。

abstract.en: Picture a field where every plant is a shared habit of a people.
abstract.cn: 想象一块田地，每一棵植物都是一个群体的共同习惯。

abstract.en: Hear museum halls as greenhouses where art flowers are raised.
abstract.cn: 把博物馆大厅想象成培育艺术花朵的温室。

abstract.en: Feel the patience of a farmer; a culture is grown slowly, year by year.
abstract.cn: 体会农夫的耐心；文化是一年一年慢慢种出来的。

examples.en: We learned about the culture of ancient Egypt in history class.
examples.cn: 历史课上我们了解了古埃及的文化。

examples.en: Every country has its own culture and festivals.
examples.cn: 每个国家都有自己的文化和节日。

examples.en: Farmers care for the culture of vegetables from spring to autumn.
examples.cn: 从春天到秋天，农民悉心照料蔬菜的种植。

definition_en: a small round container for drinking; the amount it holds; a prize
core_image: 双手捧起的一个小圆容器
scene: 跑完八百米，同学递给我水壶，我一口气喝了半瓶。She poured some warm water into a cup for the tired runner.
sceneCN: 这里 cup 是「杯子」（第 1 个义项：喝水用的小圆容器）；句意是她给疲惫的跑者往杯子里倒了些温水。

derivatives.zh: 由 cup 加 -ful 构成，义为「一满杯」
由 cup 加 board 构成，义为「碗柜；橱柜」

senses.title: A small round drinking container
senses.definition: a small round container with a handle, used for hot drinks
senses.definitionCN: 带把手的小圆容器，常用来喝热饮
senses.example: Grandpa holds his cup with both hands because the tea is hot.
senses.exampleCN: 茶太烫，爷爷双手捧着杯子。
senses.why: Hands naturally curve to hold liquid, so the round open shape got a name of its own.
senses.whyCN: 双手捧水时会自然弯成弧形，这种圆口盛液的形状便有了自己的名字。

senses.title: The amount a cup holds
senses.definition: the quantity that a cup can contain, often in recipes
senses.definitionCN: 一个杯子能装下的量，常用于菜谱
senses.example: Add a cup of milk to the cake mixture.
senses.exampleCN: 往蛋糕糊里加一杯牛奶。
senses.why: The container became a unit of measure because cooks poured by cupfuls.
senses.whyCN: 厨师们按杯倒料，容器便变成了计量单位。

senses.title: A prize in a competition
senses.definition: a silver or gold cup given as a prize in a contest
senses.definitionCN: 比赛获胜者获得的金银奖杯
senses.example: Our school team won the cup at the football final.
senses.exampleCN: 我们校队在足球决赛中赢得了奖杯。
senses.why: A fine cup was once a precious gift for winners, so the award took the container's name.
senses.whyCN: 精致的杯子曾是献给优胜者的贵重礼物，于是奖项借用了容器的名字。

intro.en: Cup goes back to a Latin word for a small tub or cask.
intro.cn: cup 可以追溯到拉丁语中指小桶、小盆的词。

items.en: The word cuppa meant a small cask or basin for drinking.
items.cn: 拉丁语 cuppa 指饮用的小桶或小盆。

items.en: English borrowed it early as cuppe, meaning a drinking vessel.
items.cn: 英语很早借入 cuppe，指饮水器皿。

items.en: By medieval times cup also meant the measure and the prize chalice.
items.cn: 中世纪时 cup 也表示容量单位和奖赏用的杯盏。

items.en: Compound words like cupboard appeared, naming furniture that once stored cups.
items.cn: cupboard 之类的复合词出现，命名曾用来存放杯子的家具。

items.en: Today cup names tableware, a recipe measure and sports trophies.
items.cn: 如今 cup 既指餐具，也指菜谱计量单位和体育奖杯。

note.en: These words name drinking containers or similar small vessels.
note.cn: 这些词指饮水容器或类似的小型器皿。

abstract.en: See the recipe line: one cup of sugar, level and exact.

abstract.en: Feel team members lifting a silver cup over their heads.

definition_en: having curls or a curving round shape
core_image: 一圈一圈绕起来的小弹簧
scene: 新转来的同学顶着一头蓬蓬的头发，像顶着一朵云。My little sister was born with soft curly hair.
sceneCN: 这里 curly 是「卷曲的」（第 1 个义项：头发一圈圈卷起来的样子）；句意是我妹妹生来就有一头柔软的卷发。

senses.title: Hair that grows in ringlets
senses.definition: hair that grows in small round twists instead of hanging straight
senses.definitionCN: 头发长成一圈圈的小弯，而不是直直垂下
senses.example: The barber cut his curly hair very short for summer.
senses.exampleCN: 理发师把他的卷发剪得很短过夏天。
senses.why: A curl is a small round twist, and hair that twists all over is called curly.
senses.whyCN: curl 是一圈小弯，头发到处都是这种小弯，就叫 curly。

senses.title: Things shaped in curves
senses.definition: having a winding or coiled shape, like fur, tails or fries
senses.definitionCN: 呈弯绕或盘卷形状，如毛发、尾巴、薯条
senses.example: The little dog has curly fur all over its back.
senses.exampleCN: 小狗背上长满了卷卷的毛。
senses.why: Any coiled surface looks like a row of curls, so the word spread to fur and shapes.
senses.whyCN: 任何盘卷的表面都像一排小卷，于是这个词扩展到毛发和形状。

intro.en: Curly comes from curl, a word of uncertain early origin.
intro.cn: curly 来自 curl，而 curl 的早期来源尚不确定。

items.en: The verb curlen appeared, meaning to curl or to ripple.
items.cn: 中古英语出现 curlen，意为卷曲、起波纹。

items.en: It is generally thought to come from a Germanic source meaning to twist or coil; the exact form is uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为它源自一个意为扭转、盘绕的日耳曼语词，具体形式不确定。

items.en: The noun curl named a ringlet of hair or a ripple of water.
items.cn: 中古英语名词 curl 指发卷或水波纹。

items.en: The adjective curly formed with the -y suffix, first about hair, later about any coiled shape.
items.cn: 加 -y 后缀构成形容词 curly，先形容头发，后泛指任何盘卷形状。

items.en: Today curly describes hair, fur, leaves and even snack food.
items.cn: 如今 curly 可形容头发、皮毛、叶子甚至零食。

note.en: These words describe twisted shapes or opposite hair types.
note.cn: 这些词形容盘卷的形状或相反的发质。

definition_en: a usual way of doing things in a group or place
core_image: 大家年年照着做、代代传下来的固定做法
scene: 春节前全家大扫除，奶奶说这是老规矩，年年都不能少。Keeping the doors clean before the new year is a Chinese custom.
sceneCN: 这里 custom 是「习俗」（第 1 个义项：群体沿袭的固定做法）；句意是春节前扫除门庭是中国的一项习俗。

senses.title: A shared way of doing things
senses.definition: an action or way of behaving that a group has followed for a long time
senses.definitionCN: 一个群体长期沿袭的做法或行为方式
senses.example: It is a custom in our town to light lanterns on the last night of the year.
senses.exampleCN: 在除夕夜点灯笼是我们镇上的习俗。
senses.why: Doing the same thing together year after year presses a groove, and the groove is a custom.
senses.whyCN: 年年一起做同样的事会压出一道「沟」，这道沟就是习俗。

senses.title: A personal habit
senses.definition: a usual practice of one person, often formal in style
senses.definitionCN: 一个人的惯常做法，语气较正式
senses.example: It is my custom to review notes before going to sleep.
senses.exampleCN: 睡前复习笔记是我的习惯。
senses.why: What a group repeats is custom; what one person repeats borrows the same word.
senses.whyCN: 群体重复的是习俗，个人重复的做法也借用同一个词。

senses.title: The government office for imported goods
senses.definition: the place at ports and borders where officials check goods brought into a country
senses.definitionCN: 港口、边境检查入境货物的机构
senses.example: We waited an hour at customs before our bags were checked.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在海关等了一个小时才检查完行李。
senses.why: Declared goods follow fixed rules, so the checking office took the word for fixed practice.
senses.whyCN: 申报货物要按固定规则办理，检查机构便沿用了「固定做法」这个词。

intro.en: Custom traces back to a Latin verb for becoming used to something.
intro.cn: custom 可追溯到拉丁语中表示「习惯于」的动词。

items.en: consuescere meant to accustom oneself; the noun consuetudo meant habit or usage.
items.cn: 拉丁语 consuescere 意为使自己习惯；名词 consuetudo 指习惯、惯例。

items.en: Old French kept it as custume, meaning habit or usage.
items.cn: 古法语保留为 custume，意为习惯、惯例。

items.en: English took custume around the twelfth century, first for a settled practice.
items.cn: 英语约在十二世纪吸收 custume，最初指固定做法。

items.en: Because traders paid regular dues, customs came to name the dues and the office that collected them.
items.cn: 因为商人定期缴纳通行税，customs 便转指税款和征税机构，即海关。

items.en: Today custom covers folkways, personal habits and the customs house at the airport.
items.cn: 如今 custom 涵盖民俗、个人习惯和机场的海关。

note.en: These words belong to the custom family or name repeated behaviour.
note.cn: 这些词属于 custom 词族，或指重复出现的行为。

examples.en: Each class has its own customs, such as cleaning the board after lessons.

examples.en: The customs officers asked us to open our suitcases.

senses.title: A person who buys things
senses.definition: someone who enters a shop or business and pays for goods or services
senses.definitionCN: 进入商店或商家并付钱购买商品或服务的人
senses.example: The first customer of the day bought two notebooks and a pen.
senses.exampleCN: 当天的第一位顾客买了两本笔记本和一支钢笔。
senses.why: Old Latin usage tied buying to settled practice; the person who follows the trade customs became the customer.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语的用法把买卖和固定惯例联系在一起，按交易惯例来往的人就成了 customer。

senses.title: A client of a service business
senses.definition: a person who uses a bank, hotel or other service rather than buying goods
senses.definitionCN: 使用银行、酒店等服务的客户，而非购买商品的人
senses.example: The bank serves thousands of customers in our city.
senses.exampleCN: 这家银行服务着本市成千上万的客户。
senses.why: Services also follow fixed routines, so the word spread from shops to banks and hotels.
senses.whyCN: 服务业同样按固定流程办事，这个词便从商店扩展到银行和酒店。

items.cn: 如今 customer 指商店的买家和银行、酒店、电话公司的客户。

abstract.en: Hear the till ring and the words thank you and come again.
abstract.cn: 听收银机响，听到「谢谢惠顾，欢迎再来」。

abstract.en: Feel the trust that makes someone come back next week.
abstract.cn: 体会让顾客下周还愿意再来的一份信任。

definition_en: to divide or open something with a sharp tool; to reduce; a wound or editing choice
core_image: 锋利的刃口把一样东西分成两半
scene: 手工课上剪刀咔嚓咔嚓，碎纸像雪花一样落下。Please cut the paper into eight equal pieces for the origami task.
sceneCN: 这里 cut 是「剪；切」（第 1 个义项：用锋利的工具把东西分开）；句意是请把纸剪成八等份做折纸。

senses.title: Divide with a sharp edge
senses.definition: to use a knife, scissors or another sharp edge to open or divide something
senses.definitionCN: 用刀、剪刀等利刃把东西割开或分开
senses.example: Cut the apple in half before you share it.
senses.exampleCN: 分享苹果之前先把它切成两半。
senses.why: A sharp edge forces things apart, so forcing apart with a blade is the root image.
senses.whyCN: 锋利的刃口能把东西强行分开，用刀刃分开东西正是这个词的根本意象。

senses.title: Reduce an amount
senses.definition: to make a price, number or amount smaller
senses.definitionCN: 使价格、数量或数额变小
senses.example: The school cut the lunch price by two yuan this term.
senses.exampleCN: 这学期学校把午餐价格降低了两元。
senses.why: Removing a slice makes the rest smaller, so cutting a piece from a sum means reducing it.
senses.whyCN: 切掉一片剩下的就变小，所以从总额上「切」一块就是削减。

senses.title: Leave out or remove
senses.definition: to remove a part from a text, film or speech
senses.definitionCN: 从文章、影片或讲话中删去一部分
senses.example: The editor cut three seconds of noise from the video.
senses.exampleCN: 剪辑师从视频里剪掉了三秒的杂音。
senses.why: Slicing away film or words is still dividing with a blade, now done in editing.
senses.whyCN: 剪掉胶片或字句仍是用「刀」分开东西，只是搬到了编辑工作里。

senses.title: A wound or slice in a surface
senses.definition: a break or opening made in the skin or in a surface
senses.definitionCN: 皮肤或表面被割开的裂口
senses.example: The nurse cleaned the small cut on my knee.
senses.exampleCN: 护士清理了我膝盖上的小伤口。
senses.why: The result of the action takes the same name as the action itself.
senses.whyCN: 动作的结果与动作共用同一个名字。

intro.en: Cut is a short English word whose early source is uncertain.
intro.cn: cut 是个简短的英语词，早期来源不确定。

items.en: The verb cutten appears in the thirteenth century, meaning to divide with a sharp edge.
items.cn: 十三世纪出现动词 cutten，意为用利刃分开东西。

items.en: Some scholars link it to Old French couteau (knife) or to Old English cyttan; no theory is fully accepted.
items.cn: 有学者把它与古法语 couteau（刀）或古英语 cyttan 联系起来，但没有一种说法被完全接受。

items.en: The noun cut followed, naming the act and the wound it leaves.
items.cn: 名词 cut 随之出现，指切割动作及其留下的伤口。

items.en: The verb spread to prices, film editing and card dealing.
items.cn: 动词的含义扩展到降价、影片剪辑和发牌。

items.en: Compounds like haircut and shortcut made the word part of daily life.
items.cn: haircut、shortcut 之类的复合词让这个词融入了日常生活。

note.en: These words name sharp actions on objects or related reductions.
note.cn: 这些词指用利刃对物体进行的动作或相关的削减。

senses.title: Pretty in a charming, lovable way

senses.example: The panda cub rolling in the snow is the cutest thing at the zoo.
senses.exampleCN: 在雪地里打滚的熊猫宝宝是动物园里最可爱的存在。
senses.why: Something small and soft invites care, so the eye calls it cute.

senses.title: Clever in a playful way
senses.definition: clever in a way that is amusing or a little too proud

senses.example: His cute answer made the whole class laugh.

abstract.en: Feel your face soften into a smile without asking.

definition_en: a father; an informal word for your male parent
core_image: 张开手臂等婴儿扑过来的那双大手
scene: 运动会四百米决赛终点，我第一个冲线，看台上有人跳起来挥手。My dad cheered louder than anyone at the finish line.
sceneCN: 这里 dad 是「爸爸」（第 1 个义项：口语中称呼父亲）；句意是在终点线，爸爸的欢呼比谁都响亮。

derivatives.zh: 由 dad 加昵称后缀 -y 构成，义为「爸爸（更亲昵）」
dad 的正式说法，义为「父亲」

senses.title: An informal word for father
senses.definition: a male parent, spoken in a warm, everyday way
senses.definitionCN: 男性家长，日常亲昵的称呼
senses.example: Dad taught me to ride a bike in the park near our home.
senses.exampleCN: 爸爸在自家附近的公园里教我骑自行车。
senses.why: Babies repeat easy sounds, and da-da was among the first syllables humans babble.
senses.whyCN: 婴儿会重复简单的音节，da-da 正是人类最早咿呀出的音之一。

senses.title: Any father as a type
senses.definition: a father considered as a kind of person, often plural or with a description
senses.definitionCN: 作为一类人的父亲，常用复数或加修饰语
senses.example: The school invited all the dads to the sports day.
senses.exampleCN: 学校邀请所有的爸爸来参加运动会。
senses.why: A family word can stand for a group once each family has one.
senses.whyCN: 家家都有父亲，这个词便能代表整个群体。

intro.en: Dad is baby talk that grew into a family word.
intro.cn: dad 源自婴儿语，后来成长为家庭称呼。

items.en: The syllable da appears in very many languages as a baby sound; scholars treat the origin as universal babble rather than one source language.
items.cn: 音节 da 在很多语言里都是婴儿音；学者认为它源自普遍的婴儿咿呀声，而非单一语言。

items.en: The word dad is recorded in English around the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 英语约在十六世纪记录下 dad 一词。

items.en: The affectionate form daddy formed with the diminutive ending.
items.cn: 加昵称词尾构成更亲昵的 daddy。

items.en: Dad spread through everyday speech as the warm counterpart of formal father.
items.cn: dad 在日常口语中流传，成为正式词 father 的亲切对应。

items.en: Modern usage adds compounds like stay-at-home dad and dad jokes.
items.cn: 现代用法又出现 stay-at-home dad（全职爸爸）、dad jokes（冷笑话）等说法。

note.en: These words name family members or close relations.
note.cn: 这些词指家庭成员或亲近的关系。

normalIntro.en: Use the sound of baby talk and the family word set.

normal.en: da-da is the first syllable many babies say, so dad sounds simple.
normal.cn: 许多宝宝最早发出的音节就是 da-da，所以 dad 听起来很简单。

normal.en: dad is informal; father is the formal word.
normal.cn: dad 是口语说法；father 是正式用词。

normal.en: Add -y for extra warmth: daddy.
normal.cn: 加 -y 更亲昵：daddy。

normal.en: Dad and mum always appear together in family lists.

normal.en: Spelling is mirror-symmetric: d-a-d.
normal.cn: 拼写左右对称：d-a-d。

abstract.en: Hear a baby shouting da-da with open arms.
abstract.cn: 听婴儿张开双臂喊 da-da。

abstract.en: Picture strong hands holding the bike seat steady.
abstract.cn: 想象有力的双手扶稳自行车后座。

abstract.en: Feel the proudest shout from the stands at a race.
abstract.cn: 体会看台上最骄傲的那声欢呼。

examples.en: Dad drives me to training every Saturday morning.
examples.cn: 每周六早上爸爸开车送我去训练。

examples.en: The children made cards for their dads on Family Day.
examples.cn: 家庭日那天，孩子们为爸爸们做了贺卡。

examples.en: My dad tells the same old joke at every dinner.
examples.cn: 我爸爸每次吃饭都讲同一个老笑话。

sensesIntro.en: From baby babble to the everyday word for father.

definition_zh: 每日的；日常的；每天；日报
definition_en: happening every day; every day; a newspaper printed every day
core_image: 太阳每天升起，事情每天照做
scene: 每天早上七点半，宿舍楼下的小卖部都挤满买早餐的学生。Brushing teeth is part of my daily morning plan.
sceneCN: 这里 daily 是「日常的」（第 1 个义项：每天都发生的）；句意是刷牙是我每天早晨计划的一部分。

derivatives.zh: daily 的基础词，义为「天；日」
由 day 加 light 构成，义为「日光；白天」

senses.title: Happening every day
senses.definition: happening or done once a day, or on every ordinary day
senses.definitionCN: 一天一次，或每个平常日子都会发生的
senses.example: Keeping a daily reading log helps me remember new words.
senses.exampleCN: 坚持每天记录阅读清单帮我记住新单词。
senses.why: Day names the unit of time; adding -ly turns the unit into an adjective about the unit.
senses.whyCN: day 是时间单位，加 -ly 后缀就把单位变成了描述它的形容词。

senses.title: Every day as an adverb
senses.definition: once each day, without missing a day
senses.definitionCN: 每天一次，一天不落
senses.example: The milk truck comes daily before six.
senses.exampleCN: 送奶车每天六点前来。
senses.why: The same suffix works twice: day by day becomes one word for each day.
senses.whyCN: 同一个后缀用两次，「一天又一天」缩成一个词，就是每天。

senses.title: A newspaper printed every day
senses.definition: a newspaper printed and sold every day
senses.definitionCN: 每天印刷发行的报纸
senses.example: Grandpa reads the daily over breakfast every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 爷爷每天早餐时读日报。
senses.why: A thing named by its schedule takes the schedule's word.
senses.whyCN: 按日程命名的事物便借用日程的词。

intro.en: Daily is simply day with an adjective ending.
intro.cn: daily 就是 day 加上形容词词尾。

items.en: dæg meant the period from sunrise to sunrise, our day.
items.cn: 古英语 dæg 指从日出到日出的时段，即一天。

items.en: The form dæglic already meant happening each day.
items.cn: 古英语形式 dæglic 已表示每天发生的。

items.en: Spelling settled as daily, keeping both adjective and adverb uses.
items.cn: 拼写定型为 daily，兼作形容词和副词。

items.en: With printing, daily became a noun for a newspaper issued every day.
items.cn: 印刷术兴起后，daily 又成为名词，指每天发行的报纸。

items.en: Today daily life, daily news and take the stairs daily are all common.
items.cn: 如今 daily life、daily news 和「每天走楼梯」都很常用。

note.en: These words belong to the day family or describe time rhythms.
note.cn: 这些词属于 day 词族，或描述时间节律。

entries.definition: a period of twenty-four hours
light from the sun during the day
milk products or a milk shop; spelled close to daily, unrelated
entries.definitionCN: 乳制品；奶店（拼写近似，词义无关）

entries.definition: a small white flower; its old name meant day's eye
entries.definitionCN: 雏菊（古义为「白昼之眼」，与 day 同源）

entries.definition: ordinary, happening commonly
happening every week
happening every month
happening at even intervals
happening every night

normalIntro.en: Build the word from day and compare the -ly time words.
normalIntro.cn: 从 day 出发拼词，并对比一组时间 -ly 词。

normal.en: day + ly = daily, one l plus y.
normal.cn: day + ly ＝ daily，一个 l 加 y。

normal.en: weekly, monthly, yearly follow the same pattern.
normal.cn: weekly（每周）、monthly（每月）、yearly（每年）同构。

normal.en: daily is both adjective and adverb: daily exercise, exercise daily.
normal.cn: daily 可作形容词和副词：daily exercise、exercise daily。

normal.en: A daily is also a newspaper printed every day.
normal.cn: daily 还可作名词，指每天出版的报纸。

normal.en: Watch out for dairy, the milk shop; one letter apart.
normal.cn: 小心别和 dairy（奶制品店）弄混，只差一个字母。

abstract.en: Picture the sun rising on schedule every single morning.
abstract.cn: 想象太阳每天准点升起。

abstract.en: Hear the same alarm at the same minute, day after day.
abstract.cn: 听每天同一分钟的同一个闹钟。

abstract.en: Feel the small tick of a calendar square being crossed out.
abstract.cn: 体会日历上格子被划掉的小小仪式感。

examples.en: Our daily walk to school takes ten minutes.
examples.cn: 我们每天步行上学要十分钟。

examples.en: Water the plant daily or it will dry out.
examples.cn: 这盆植物要每天浇水，不然会干枯。

examples.en: The school daily reports football results every Friday.
examples.cn: 学校日报每周五报道足球比赛结果。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「得累」——每天都做的事，天天「得累」，所以是日常的

root: 来自古英语 dæg（天）加形容词后缀 -lic，dæglic 本指「每天的」；中古英语定型为 daily，兼作形容词与副词，近代又转指日报。

sensesIntro.en: The word fills one rhythm: once a day, day after day.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词只填一种节律：一天一次，天天如此。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the sun rising again, so the same things repeat
core.cn: 核心意象：太阳照常升起，事情天天重演

branches.en: Adjective and adverb of one rhythm
branches.cn: 同一节律的形容词与副词

intro.en: Daily shows the -ly pattern used for time words.
intro.cn: daily 展示了 -ly 用在时间词上的构词法。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the family is Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词根，词族来自古英语。

items.exampleCN: a yearly trip（一年一次的旅行）

items.meaning: milk products; spelled near daily, unrelated
items.meaningCN: 乳制品（拼写近似，词义无关）

definition_en: to move the body to music; a set of steps to music; a dancing event
core_image: 身体跟着节拍画出的圆弧
scene: 元旦晚会的彩排教室里，音乐一响大家就排成一行。We learned a simple folk dance for the new year show.
sceneCN: 这里 dance 是「舞蹈」（第 2 个义项：配上音乐的一套动作）；句意是为元旦演出我们学了一段简单的民间舞。

derivatives.zh: 由 dance 加表示人的后缀 -er 构成，义为「舞者；舞蹈演员」
由 dance 加 -ing 构成，义为「跳舞（活动）」

senses.title: Move the body to music
senses.definition: to move your feet and body in time with music
senses.definitionCN: 让手脚和身体跟着音乐节拍动起来
senses.example: The whole class danced at the party until eight o'clock.
senses.exampleCN: 全班同学在晚会上一直跳到八点。
senses.why: Music pulls the body into rhythm, and moving to that pull is the basic act.
senses.whyCN: 音乐牵引身体进入节奏，跟着这种牵引动起来就是最基本的动作。

senses.title: A set of steps; the art
senses.definition: a series of steps and movements to music, or the art of performing them
senses.definitionCN: 配乐的一系列舞步，或表演这门艺术
senses.example: Our folk dance won first prize at the festival.
senses.exampleCN: 我们的民间舞蹈在艺术节得了第一名。
senses.why: When the repeated moves get a name, the act becomes a work.
senses.whyCN: 重复的动作有了名字，动作就成了一件作品。

senses.title: A dancing event
senses.definition: a party or event where people dance together
senses.definitionCN: 大家一起跳舞的聚会活动
senses.example: The end-of-term dance is held in the school hall.
senses.exampleCN: 学期末舞会在学校礼堂举行。
senses.why: An event named by what people do there, as lunch names the meal.
senses.whyCN: 用人们在场上的活动命名活动本身，就像 lunch 命名那顿饭。

intro.en: Dance came into English through French, but its deepest source is uncertain.
intro.cn: dance 经法语进入英语，但更深的来源不确定。

items.en: Some point to a Frankish word meaning to stretch or draw oneself; others compare Old High German dansôn; no theory is certain.
items.cn: 有人指向法兰克语中表示「伸展、牵引」的词，也有人比较古高地德语 dansôn，均无定论。

items.en: Old French had dancier, meaning to move in steps to music.
items.cn: 古法语有 dancier，意为踏着音乐移动舞步。

items.en: English took dance in the thirteenth century, both verb and noun.
items.cn: 英语在十三世纪吸收 dance，动词名词兼有。

items.en: The sense soon covered ballroom events and set pieces of choreography.
items.cn: 词义很快覆盖舞会与成套的舞步作品。

items.en: Today dance names a school subject, a sport and a worldwide art form.
items.cn: 如今 dance 指一门课程、一项运动和世界性的艺术形式。

note.en: These words describe moving to music or the art of it.
note.cn: 这些词描述随乐而动或这门艺术。

entries.definition: a person who dances
the activity of dancing
small and delicate; spelled a little like dance, unrelated
entries.definitionCN: 小巧精致的（拼写略似，词义无关）

a smooth three-step ballroom dance
a single step in a dance
the beat pattern music follows

normalIntro.en: Use the sound, the family and the school words.
normalIntro.cn: 用发音、词族和校园用语来记。

normal.en: dance + er = dancer; dance + ing = dancing.
normal.cn: dance + er ＝ dancer（舞者）；dance + ing ＝ dancing。

normal.en: dance to the music, not dance with the music.
normal.cn: 说 dance to the music（随乐起舞），不说 dance with the music。

normal.en: a dance is one piece; dancing is the whole activity.
normal.cn: a dance 指一支舞；dancing 指跳舞这件事。

normal.en: UK says DAHNS with a long a; US says DANS with a short a.
normal.cn: 英式读 DAHNS（长音 a），美式读 DANS（短音 a）。

normal.en: folk dance, ballet and hip-hop are all dances.
normal.cn: folk dance（民族舞）、ballet（芭蕾）、hip-hop 都是舞蹈。

abstract.en: Feel the beat pulling your foot before your mind agrees.
abstract.cn: 体会节拍抢在意识之前拉动脚尖。

abstract.en: Draw the shape of a dance line on the floor with your eyes.
abstract.cn: 用眼睛在地板上描出队形的弧线。

abstract.en: Hear applause explode when the last freeze lands.
abstract.cn: 听最后一帧定格时炸开的掌声。

examples.en: The twins danced together on the sports day stage.
examples.cn: 运动会的舞台上，双胞胎一起跳舞。

examples.en: Every culture has its own dances and music.
examples.cn: 每种文化都有自己的舞蹈和音乐。

examples.en: I go dancing with my friends every weekend.
examples.cn: 我每个周末都和朋友去跳舞。

sensesIntro.en: The word moves from the act, to the art, to the event.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从动作，到艺术，再到舞会活动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the body drawing arcs along the beat

intro.en: Dance forms people and activity words easily.
intro.cn: dance 很容易构成表示人和活动的词。

waltz at the ball（舞会上跳华尔兹）

definition_zh: 危险；险境；危险的人或物
definition_en: the possibility that someone or something will be harmed
core_image: 深潭边缘那块摇摇晃晃的湿石头
scene: 游泳课结束前，教练站在池边举起红色提示牌。The coach reminded us that the deep end of the pool is a danger for beginners.
sceneCN: 这里 danger 是「危险」（第 1 个义项：可能受到伤害的状况）；句意是教练提醒我们泳池深水区对初学者来说有危险。

derivatives.zh: 由 danger 加形容词后缀 -ous 构成，义为「危险的」
由动词前缀 en- 加 danger 构成，义为「危及；使遭受危险」

senses.title: The chance of being hurt
senses.definition: the possibility that harm, injury or loss will happen
senses.definitionCN: 伤害、损失可能发生的状态
senses.example: Cyclists should know that riding without a helmet is a danger.
senses.exampleCN: 骑自行车的人应该明白，不戴头盔骑行是危险的。
senses.why: A narrow slippery ledge holds you above harm, so the place itself feels like the possibility of harm.
senses.whyCN: 又窄又滑的岩沿悬在伤害之上，那个位置本身就让人感到危险的可能。

senses.title: A person or thing that can cause harm
senses.definition: a person, animal or thing that may cause harm
senses.definitionCN: 可能造成伤害的人、动物或事物
senses.example: The broken swing in the playground is a danger to small children.
senses.exampleCN: 游乐场里坏掉的秋千对小孩子是个危险物。
senses.why: When the source of the possibility can be pointed at, the pointer gets the name.
senses.whyCN: 当危险的可能性能被指认出源头，源头便获得了这个名字。

intro.en: Danger once meant the power of a lord over your fate.
intro.cn: danger 最初的意思是「领主对你命运的支配权」。

items.en: dominium meant lordly power or ownership, from dominus, a lord or master.
items.cn: 拉丁语 dominium 意为主人的权力或所有权，来自 dominus（主人）。

items.en: Old French dangier meant power to harm, the authority of a lord.

definition_en: a day of the month or year; an appointment; a sweet fruit; to write the date
core_image: 日历上被圈出的那个格子
scene: 发试卷时老师提醒大家先写名字和考试日。Please write your name and the date at the top of the paper.
sceneCN: 这里 date 是「日期」（第 1 个义项：某月某日）；句意是请在试卷顶端写上姓名和日期。

derivatives.zh: 由 up 加 date 构成，义为「更新；使现代化」
date 的过去分词转形容词，义为「过时的；注有日期的」

senses.title: A day of the month or year
senses.definition: a numbered day of a month, often written on papers and diaries
senses.definitionCN: 某月中的某一天，常写在文件和日记上
senses.example: The exam date is written on the notice board.
senses.exampleCN: 考试日期写在通知栏上。
senses.why: Calendars cut time into squares, and each square needs its own label.
senses.whyCN: 日历把时间切成格子，每个格子都需要一个标签。

senses.title: An appointment, especially romantic
senses.definition: a planned meeting with someone, especially a romantic one
senses.definitionCN: 事先约好的会面，尤指恋人间的
senses.example: They watched a film on their first date.
senses.exampleCN: 他们第一次约会看了一场电影。
senses.why: A fixed meeting shares the fixed square of time, so the appointment borrowed the calendar word.
senses.whyCN: 定好的会面占用固定的时刻，于是约会借用了日历的词。

senses.title: A sweet brown fruit
senses.definition: a sweet sticky brown fruit from a palm tree
senses.definitionCN: 棕榈树结出的甜而黏的褐色果实
senses.example: We ate dates and nuts at the festival.
senses.exampleCN: 节日期间我们吃了椰枣和坚果。
senses.why: A homonym from Arabic: the fruit came with its own word and landed on the same spelling.
senses.whyCN: 这是来自阿拉伯语的同形异源词：果实带着自己的词，碰巧与「日期」同形。

senses.title: To write or fix the time
senses.definition: to write the day on something, or to say how old something is
senses.definitionCN: 在某物上写日期，或判断某物的年代
senses.example: The bridge dates back to the Qing dynasty.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥的历史可以追溯到清代。
senses.why: Papers must carry their time square, so the verb stamps it on.
senses.whyCN: 文书必须携带自己的时间坐标，动词便把这个坐标「盖」上去。

intro.en: Date the time word and date the fruit come from different sources that met in spelling.
intro.cn: 「日期」义的 date 和「枣」义的 date 来源不同，只是拼写相遇。

items.en: datum meant given, the past participle of dare, to give; letters were marked datum, given (at this place and time).
items.cn: 拉丁语 datum 意为「被给予的」，是 dare（给予）的过去分词；书信结尾标注 datum，即「写于此地此时」。

items.en: The fruit word came separately from Greek daktylos, finger, via Arabic into Latin as dactylus.
items.cn: 果实的词另出一源：希腊语 daktylos（手指），经阿拉伯语进入拉丁语作 dactylus。

items.en: Old French carried date, the time sense, into learned writing.
items.cn: 古法语把表时间的 date 带进书面语。

items.en: English took the time sense in the fourteenth century; the fruit sense arrived a century later.
items.cn: 英语十四世纪吸收时间义；果实义晚一个世纪传入。

items.en: Modern use adds dating events, out of date and digital dates on files.
items.cn: 现代用法又有了事件断代、out of date（过时）和文件的数字日期。

note.en: These words share the dare root, the fruit word, or the calendar field.
note.cn: 这些词与 dare 词根或果实词同源，或同属日历词场。

having a date; old-fashioned
given facts; from the same Latin dare family
entries.definitionCN: 数据（同源，源于 dare「给予」）

normalIntro.en: Use the calendar image and the dare word family.
normalIntro.cn: 用日历画面和 dare 词族来记。

normal.en: Latin dare means to give; a date is the day a document is given.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 dare 意为「给」；date 就是文件被给出的那一天。

normal.en: date back to tells how old something is.
normal.cn: date back to 表示某物可追溯到何时。

normal.en: out of date is old; up to date is new.
normal.cn: out of date 是过时；up to date 是最新。

normal.en: The fruit date and the time date are different words that spell alike.
normal.cn: 果实义的 date 与时间义的 date 是两个词源不同的同形词。

normal.en: update = up + date, moving to today's square.
normal.cn: update ＝ up + date，更新到今天的格子。

abstract.en: Circle one square on a paper calendar with a red pen.
abstract.cn: 用红笔在纸质日历上圈出一个格子。

abstract.en: Taste a sweet sticky date with your tea.
abstract.cn: 就着茶尝一颗又甜又黏的椰枣。

abstract.en: Stamp the corner of a letter with the day and place.
abstract.cn: 在信的角落盖下日期和地点。

examples.en: The school sports meet is fixed for a date in late April.
examples.cn: 学校运动会定在四月下旬的某一天。

examples.en: This timetable is out of date; the buses leave ten minutes earlier now.
examples.cn: 这张时刻表过时了，现在公交车提前十分钟发车。

examples.en: Dates from the market were sweet and chewy.
examples.cn: 市场上买的椰枣又甜又有嚼劲。

sensesIntro.cn: 两个不相关的词在同一个拼写里相遇：日子、果实和约会。

core.cn: 核心意象：日历上被圈出的那个格子

definition_en: a person's female child
core_image: 牵着妈妈衣角的小女孩
scene: 家长会结束，妈妈牵着我的手走出教室，一路都在和老师道谢。The proud mother walked home with her daughter after the prize day.
sceneCN: 这里 daughter 是「女儿」（第 1 个义项：某人的女性孩子）；句意是颁奖日之后，自豪的妈妈牵着女儿走回家。

derivatives.zh: 由 daughter 加 in-law 构成，义为「儿媳」
daughter 的对应词，义为「儿子」

senses.title: A female child
senses.definition: a girl or woman in relation to her parents
senses.definitionCN: 相对于父母的女孩或女性
senses.example: Their daughter practices the piano every evening.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的女儿每天傍晚练习钢琴。
senses.why: Family trees split by sex, and each branch keeps its own name.
senses.whyCN: 家谱按性别分岔，每根枝条都有自己的名字。

senses.title: A female descendant or product
senses.definition: a woman of a later generation of a place or group; in science, a cell formed by division
senses.definitionCN: 某地、某群体的后一代女性；科学中指分裂形成的子细胞
senses.example: Beijing's daughters and sons study all over the world.
senses.exampleCN: 北京的女儿和儿子们在世界各地求学。
senses.why: Family words branch outward to cities and even to dividing cells.
senses.whyCN: 家庭用词会向外分岔，延伸到城市甚至分裂的细胞。

intro.en: Daughter is an ancient family word shared across Indo-European languages.
intro.cn: daughter 是横跨印欧语系的古老家庭词。

items.en: A reconstructed form dauhtiz named a female child in the common Germanic parent language.
items.cn: 重构形式 dauhtiz 在日耳曼语系共同祖先语中指女性孩子。

items.en: Old English had dohtor, the female child of parents.
items.cn: 古英语作 dohtor，指父母的女性孩子。

items.en: Spelling settled toward daughter with its unusual -gh-.
items.cn: 拼写定型为带特殊 -gh- 的 daughter。

items.en: Extended uses appeared for women of a later generation.
items.cn: 扩展用法出现，指后一代的女性。

items.en: Science borrowed the image: daughter cells and daughter companies.
items.cn: 科学界借用这个意象：daughter cells（子细胞）、daughter companies（子公司）。

note.en: These words name family roles across generations.
note.cn: 这些词指代各代家庭成员的角色。

entries.definition: more than one female child
the wife of one's son
the sound of laughing; spelled close to daughter, unrelated
entries.definitionCN: 笑声（拼写近似，词义无关）

entries.definition: a male child
a girl with the same parents
a young person of parents
the daughter of one's child
a female parent

normalIntro.en: Use the family set and watch the spelling trap.
normalIntro.cn: 用家庭词组记忆，并小心拼写陷阱。

normal.en: daughter vs laughter: only d and l differ, meanings are far apart.
normal.cn: daughter 与 laughter 只差 d 和 l，词义相去甚远。

normal.en: son is the male pair: son and daughter.
normal.cn: son 是对应的男性说法：son and daughter。

normal.en: Add grand- for the next generation: granddaughter.
normal.cn: 加 grand- 表示下一代：granddaughter（孙女）。

normal.en: In science, daughter cells come from one dividing cell.
normal.cn: 科学里 daughter cells（子细胞）由一个细胞分裂而来。

normal.en: Say the family list in order: mother, father, son, daughter.
normal.cn: 按顺序念家庭词：mother、father、son、daughter。

abstract.en: Picture small shoes lined up beside big ones at the door.
abstract.cn: 想象门口小鞋子与大鞋子排在一起。

abstract.en: Hear a baby's first two-word sentence: mum go.
abstract.cn: 听婴儿最早的句子：「妈妈走」。

abstract.en: Feel the tiny hand tugging your sleeve at the school gate.
abstract.cn: 体会校门口小手拉住衣角的触感。

examples.en: The king's daughter studied medicine in another city.
examples.cn: 国王的女儿在另一座城市学医。

examples.en: Mothers and daughters often share the same hobbies.
examples.cn: 母女之间常有相同的爱好。

examples.en: Our neighbour's daughter won the writing prize this year.
examples.cn: 我们邻居的女儿今年获得了写作奖。

sensesIntro.cn: 从一个家庭角色，延伸到代际乃至分裂的细胞。

core.cn: 核心意象：牵着妈妈衣角的小女孩

definition_en: a period of twenty-four hours; the time between sunrise and sunset; a special time
core_image: 太阳从升到落的完整一圈
scene: 运动会的横幅挂在操场，礼花在天亮前的薄雾里准备好了。The sports meet will last two days, from Monday to Tuesday.
sceneCN: 这里 day 是「天；一日」（第 1 个义项：二十四小时的时间单位）；句意是运动会将从周一持续到周二共两天。

derivatives.zh: 由 day 加 -ly 构成，义为「每日的」
由 day 加 light 构成，义为「日光；白昼」
由 birth 加 day 构成，义为「生日」
由 holy 加 day 构成，义为「假日」

senses.title: A period of twenty-four hours
senses.definition: a unit of time equal to twenty-four hours, counted from midnight
senses.definitionCN: 从零点算起的二十四小时时间单位
senses.example: We waited two days for the exam results.
senses.exampleCN: 我们等了两天才出考试成绩。
senses.why: Earth turns once, and one turn is the natural box for counting time.
senses.whyCN: 地球自转一圈，这一圈就是计算时间的天然单位。

senses.title: The time between sunrise and sunset
senses.definition: the bright part of the day when the sun is up
senses.definitionCN: 太阳升起到落下的明亮时段
senses.example: Cats sleep most of the day and wake at night.
senses.exampleCN: 猫白天大部分时间在睡觉，夜里醒来。
senses.why: Light divides the circle in two, and the bright half borrows the whole name.
senses.whyCN: 光把一个昼夜分成两半，明亮的那一半借用了整体的名字。

senses.title: A special or memorable time
senses.definition: a special occasion, or a period in the past
senses.definitionCN: 特别的场合，或过去的一段时期
senses.example: In my grandma's days, there was no mobile phone.
senses.exampleCN: 在奶奶那个年代，还没有手机。
senses.why: A remembered square on the calendar becomes a story about all squares.
senses.whyCN: 日历上被记住的一个格子，会变成关于整段岁月的故事。

intro.en: Day is a native English word as old as English itself.
intro.cn: day 是英语本土词，与英语本身一样古老。

items.en: dæg meant the day, both the twenty-four hours and the daylight.
items.cn: 古英语 dæg 指「天」，兼指二十四小时和白昼。

items.en: It comes from a Germanic root shared with related words for heat or burning; the exact link is uncertain.
items.cn: 它来自日耳曼语词根，与表示「热、燃烧」的词同族；具体联系不确定。

items.en: Spelling settled as day, with plural days.
items.cn: 拼写定型为 day，复数 days。

items.en: Compounds grew fast: birthday, holiday, weekday.
items.cn: 复合词快速增长：birthday、holiday、weekday。

items.en: Today day runs idioms like day by day and call it a day.
items.cn: 如今 day 活跃在 day by day（一天天地）和 call it a day（收工）等习语中。

note.en: These words share the day root or live in the calendar field.
note.cn: 这些词与 day 同根，或同属日历词场。

normalIntro.cn: 用复合词家族和昼夜对照来记。

normal.en: day + light = daylight; day + break = daybreak.
normal.cn: day + light ＝ daylight（日光）；day + break ＝ daybreak（黎明）。

normal.en: every day means each day; everyday as one word means ordinary.
normal.cn: every day 指每天；合写的 everyday 指平常的。

normal.en: day and night is the fixed pair.
normal.cn: day and night 是固定搭配（日日夜夜）。

normal.en: in those days points to the past, not today.
normal.cn: in those days 指过去那些日子。

normal.en: Long vowel: day rhymes with play and say.
normal.cn: day 长元音，与 play、say 押韵。

abstract.en: Watch the sun draw one full arc from east to west.
abstract.cn: 看太阳从东到西画出一道完整弧线。

abstract.en: Tear off one calendar page each morning.
abstract.cn: 想象每天清晨撕下一页日历。

abstract.en: Recall one golden day you wish to keep forever.
abstract.cn: 回想一个你想永远留住的金色日子。

examples.en: There are seven days in a week.
examples.cn: 一周有七天。

examples.en: In winter the day is short and the night is long.
examples.cn: 冬天白天短，夜晚长。

examples.en: The old photos brought back the happy days of childhood.
examples.cn: 老照片勾起了童年的快乐日子。

sensesIntro.en: One turn of the earth gives us the day, the daylight and our days.
sensesIntro.cn: 地球自转一圈，给了我们「一天」「白昼」和「那些日子」。

definition_zh: 死的；失去生命的；没电的；死寂的
definition_en: no longer alive; without power or activity
core_image: 停止摆动的钟摆
scene: 上课铃响后，手机屏幕黑了怎么按也不亮，原来是彻底没电了。The phone in his pocket was dead by lunchtime.
sceneCN: 这里 dead 是「没电的」（第 3 个义项：失去功能、不再运作）；句意是到午饭时他口袋里的手机彻底没电了。

derivatives.zh: dead 的基础动词，义为「死；死亡」
由 die 加名词化后缀 -th 构成，义为「死亡」
由 dead 加 -ly 构成，义为「致命的」

senses.title: No longer alive
senses.definition: having no life any more, said of people, animals and plants
senses.definitionCN: 不再有生命，用于人、动物和植物
senses.example: The gardener cut away the dead branches in early spring.
senses.exampleCN: 初春时园丁剪掉了枯死的树枝。
senses.why: When life leaves, movement and warmth leave with it.
senses.whyCN: 生命离开时，活动与温度也一同离去。

senses.title: Without power or function
senses.definition: not working, because it has no power or signal
senses.definitionCN: 因无电或无信号而无法工作
senses.example: The old walkie-talkie went dead during the drill.
senses.exampleCN: 演习时旧对讲机没了声音。
senses.why: A stopped machine is as silent as a stopped heart, so machines borrow the word.
senses.whyCN: 停摆的机器和停止跳动的心一样安静，机器便借用了这个词。

senses.title: Complete silence or stillness
senses.definition: total, with no movement or sound
senses.definitionCN: 完全没有动静或声音
senses.example: A dead silence filled the hall before the results were read.
senses.exampleCN: 公布结果前，大厅里一片死寂。
senses.why: The strongest degree borrows the image of lifelessness.
senses.whyCN: 最高的程度借用了「毫无生气」的画面。

intro.en: Dead is the old adjective form of the verb die.
intro.cn: dead 是动词 die 的古老形容词形式。

items.en: The verb die grew from Old Norse deyja, to pass away.
items.cn: 动词 die 源自古诺斯语 deyja（离世）。

items.en: The adjective form dead was already in Old English, from Germanic dauþaz.
items.cn: 形容词 dead 已见于古英语，源自日耳曼语 dauþaz。

items.en: The same root dau- appears in the Gothic word for death; the root means to pass away.
items.cn: 同一词根 dau- 也见于哥特语的「死亡」一词，本义为「离世」。

items.en: Noun death and adjective dead settled in their modern jobs.
items.cn: 名词 death 与形容词 dead 各自定型。

items.en: Modern English extends dead to batteries, towns and silence.
items.cn: 现代英语把 dead 扩展到电池、死城和死寂。

note.en: These words belong to the death family or describe stopped things.
note.cn: 这些词属于死亡词族，或描述停摆的事物。

items.meaning: unable to hear; spelled near dead

definition_en: unable to hear, completely or partly; unwilling to listen
core_image: 安静世界里挥动的双手
scene: 学校手语社团招新，展板前同学们跟着视频学简单的问候手势。My deaf classmate taught us to sign good morning.
sceneCN: 这里 deaf 是「失聪的」（第 1 个义项：听不见或听力受损）；句意是我的听障同学教我们用手语打「早上好」。

derivatives.zh: 由 deaf 加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「耳聋；失聪」
由 deaf 加动词后缀 -en 构成，义为「使震耳欲聋」

senses.title: Unable to hear
senses.definition: not able to hear at all, or only partly, because of damage to the ears
senses.definitionCN: 因耳朵受损而完全或部分听不见
senses.example: Deaf fans enjoyed the concert through the vibrations of the floor.
senses.exampleCN: 失聪的观众通过地板的震动欣赏音乐会。
senses.why: When a door of the senses closes, the word records which door it was.
senses.whyCN: 感官之门关闭时，这个词记录下是哪一扇门。

senses.title: Unwilling to listen
senses.definition: refusing to listen to advice, warnings or requests
senses.definitionCN: 拒绝听从劝告、警告或请求
senses.example: He turned a deaf ear to our warnings about the icy path.
senses.exampleCN: 他对我们关于结冰路面的警告充耳不闻。
senses.why: The closed ear can be by choice, so refusal borrows the same word.
senses.whyCN: 耳朵可以因选择而「关闭」，拒绝便借用了同一个词。

intro.en: Deaf is an old Germanic word about closed ears.
intro.cn: deaf 是个关于「闭上的耳朵」的古老日耳曼词。

items.en: deaf already meant unable to hear in Old English.
items.cn: 古英语的 deaf 已经表示听不见。

items.en: It comes from a Germanic root also seen in related words for empty or dull; the exact picture is uncertain.
items.cn: 它出自日耳曼词根，该词根也见于表示「空、钝」的词；具体画面不确定。

items.en: Spelling settled as deaf, pronounced with a short vowel.
items.cn: 拼写定型为 deaf，读短元音。

items.en: The idiom turn a deaf ear spread in common speech.
items.cn: 习语 turn a deaf ear 在民间话语中流行。

items.en: Modern usage prefers deaf people and hearing-impaired in careful language, plus compounds like tone-deaf.
items.cn: 现代用语在正式场合用 deaf people、hearing-impaired，另有 tone-deaf（五音不全）等复合词。

note.en: These words belong to the hearing family or describe closed senses.
note.cn: 这些词属于听觉词族，或描述关闭的感官。

abstract.cn: 想象双手在空中「说」出整句话。

abstract.en: Feel the bass of drums through your feet at a concert.

abstract.en: See a warning letter left unopened on the desk.

examples.cn: 图书馆为失聪儿童提供手语故事时间。

examples.en: Loud concerts can leave your ears half deaf for a day.
examples.cn: 吵闹的音乐会可能让你的耳朵半天听不清。

examples.en: Don't turn a deaf ear to the teacher's safety tips.
examples.cn: 别对老师的安全提示充耳不闻。

items.meaning: to share out; spelled near deaf, unrelated
items.meaningCN: 发牌；交易（拼写近似，词义无关）

definition_zh: 处理；发牌；交易；协议；许多
definition_en: to give out cards or share things; to handle a problem; an agreement or amount
core_image: 把一叠卡片一张张分到每个人面前
scene: 班级义卖结束后，大家围在课桌前商量捐出去的金额和剩下的物品。We made a deal to give half of our profits to the library fund.
sceneCN: 这里 deal 是「协议；约定」（第 3 个义项：双方商定的安排）；句意是我们约定把一半利润捐给图书馆基金。

derivatives.zh: 由 deal 加表示人的后缀 -er 构成，义为「商人；发牌人」
由 deal 加 -ing 构成，义为「交易；往来」
deal 的复数名词用法，义为「（商业）往来」

senses.title: Give out cards or shares
senses.definition: to hand out cards in a game, or share things among people
senses.definitionCN: 游戏中发牌，或在人们之间分东西
senses.example: Whose turn is it to deal the cards this round?
senses.exampleCN: 这轮该谁发牌？
senses.why: One hand moves around the table giving equal shares, the picture of fair division.
senses.whyCN: 一只手绕桌分发等量的牌，这就是公平分配的画面。

senses.title: Handle or manage
senses.definition: to take action about a problem or task
senses.definitionCN: 对问题或任务采取行动
senses.example: Our monitor deals with lost-and-found items every Friday.
senses.exampleCN: 我们班长每周五处理失物招领的事。
senses.why: Sharing out work until it is finished is the same motion as sharing cards.
senses.whyCN: 把任务一份份「分」掉直到做完，与发牌是同一个动作。

senses.title: An agreement between sides
senses.definition: a business arrangement or bargain agreed by two or more sides
senses.definitionCN: 双方或多方商定的商业安排
senses.example: The two clubs struck a deal to share the training field.
senses.exampleCN: 两家俱乐部达成协议共用训练场。
senses.why: When cards are shared fairly, both players accept the result; business copied the game.
senses.whyCN: 牌分得公平双方都认账，商业便照搬了这个游戏的规则。

senses.title: A large amount
senses.definition: a large quantity, used in phrases like a great deal of
senses.definitionCN: 大量，用于 a great deal of 等短语
senses.example: A great deal of practice went into that perfect jump.
senses.exampleCN: 那次完美的跳跃背后是大量的练习。
senses.why: A pile of dealt cards is a big number in the hand, so the heap of cards became a heap of amount.
senses.whyCN: 发到手里的牌是很大一叠，牌堆便变成了「大量」的意象。

intro.en: Deal began as a simple word for sharing things out.
intro.cn: deal 最初只是个表示「分发」的简单词。

items.en: dæl meant a part or share.
items.cn: 古英语 dæl 意为一份、部分。

items.en: The verb dælan meant to divide and distribute.
items.cn: 动词 dælan 意为分开、分配。

items.en: The root is shared with words for part or portion across Germanic languages.
items.cn: 该词根与日耳曼诸语言中表示「部分」的词同源。

items.en: Card games fixed the dealing sense in daily speech.
items.cn: 纸牌游戏把「发牌」义固定在日常生活里。

items.en: Business talk then built deal as agreement, and a great deal as amount.
items.cn: 商业用语又把 deal 变成协议，a great deal 变成大量。

note.en: These words share the share root or describe handling and trading.
note.cn: 这些词与「份额」词根同源，或描述处理与交易。
